notes: Phase 1 of undo/redo expansion: fixed title move/resize undo closure bug in createCollageLifecycle.js. The bug caused titleUndoSnapshot to be captured by reference in the undo closure, then nulled before undo execution — resulting in TypeError. Fix copies snapshot values to a local preState constant before building closures, matching the existing crop drag undo pattern. Added 11 unit tests covering the fix pattern, null guards, unchanged-state guards, per-property change detection, and multi-cycle undo/redo. Addressed world-review warning (defensive this.titleStyle guard) and suggestions (Y-only change test, multi-cycle interaction test). All 1,445 tests pass.
